name: 핫삼
wear: Rounded crimson pincer-shaped forearm guards with black teardrop markings frame but never replace the open human hands; small translucent split wing-cape panels, three blunt red crest tabs as a head ornament, polished red segmented leg armor and black flexible joints.

casual.scene: Alone backstage at a science-fiction stage event at dusk, checking the cuff of an original courier-themed event costume. Both forearms in crop, one hand lightly adjusting the opposite cuff; red curtain and warm dressing lights, no mirror, writing or other people.
casual.outfit: Opaque crimson sleeveless cropped zip vest with a secured high neckline, black high-waisted tailored shorts, small silver teardrop stud earrings. Bare shoulders arms and midriff; original decorative event costume without insignia or armor.

casual.scene: In a quiet rooftop succulent garden at cool sunrise, kneeling beside a low terracotta planter while positioning a smooth pebble on its soil with one hand, the other rests open on her raised knee. Entire head hands and feet visible, quiet blue buildings and soft pink sky.
casual.outfit: Opaque ivory sleeveless rib-knit cropped top, red high-waisted relaxed culottes and flat black sandals. Bare arms midriff and lower calves, tiny black teardrop pendant.

casual.scene: At an empty modern sculpture-gallery terrace after rain at night, leaning sideways against a low stone plinth, face turned to camera, both empty hands resting separately on its top. Head through knees visible, red reflection from an abstract light installation, no signage.
casual.outfit: Black opaque square-neck sleeveless fitted top and crimson high-waisted asymmetric midi skirt with a side slit, small silver stud earrings. Bare arms shoulders and part of one leg; sleek fabric only, no metal armor.
